- Star 2: [Mg/H]₂ = 0 dex, [Mg/Si]₂ = 0.3 dex → [Si/H]₂ = [Mg/H]₂ – [Mg/Si]₂ = –0.3 dex.

The ratio of silicon atoms (by number density relative to hydrogen) in Star 1 to Star 2 is:

(n_Si/n_H)₁ / (n_Si/n_H)₂ = 10^([Si/H]₁ – [Si/H]₂) = 10^(0.3 – (–0.3)) = 10^0.6 ≈ 3.98 ≈ 3.9.

The stellar masses and solar absolute abundances are not needed for this ratio, as the problem asks for the relative Si content assuming comparable photospheric conditions. The correct option is (D).
